title: Design and download scoped product shipment quantities as Excel
description: A user opens a visual field selector from the existing product sales ranking and previews/downloads a bounded Top result. Define a finite quantity-evidence catalog (rank, product ID/code/name, spec, unit and shipment quantity) with ordered selected keys, dates and Top; exclude the legacy current-price money estimate from this designer. Validate unknown/duplicate/empty keys and date/Top before reads. New catalog/preview/Excel endpoints independently require current identity, product-sales-ranking menu and fresh salesperson customer scope and reuse the prerequisite application method; no parallel raw/unscoped source query. The preview and Excel must clearly label Top-limited results, approved shipment evidence, date context and incompatible units; never claim completeness beyond Top or combine quantities across units. Designer retains dates, Top and selected order between preview and Excel and shows loading/denied/validation/empty/network errors using safe text. Reuse ExcelExporter for typed numeric quantities/rank and formula-safe labels; no new dependency or DI registration is required for the controller. Development only: reuse existing ERP report services, the product-sales-ranking menu and current-user SalespersonDataScopeService; existing OperationLogMiddleware records HTTP audit. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, permission expansion, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure edits, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible actions, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory API/service/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external environments must be marked blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Finite catalog and validated DTO/rules support only quantity-evidence fields and ordered selection; catalog/preview/Excel reauthorize current menu/customer scope and invoke the same bounded source service.

The existing report opens a field designer preserving dates/Top/column order; preview labels Top-limited approved shipment evidence and shows empty/denied/validation/network states without misleading money or cross-unit totals.

Excel reruns authorization/validation and exports only selected Top result fields using numeric cells and formula-safe text with date/Top/unit context; focused API/workbook/UI tests and safe Release build/test pass.
